cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

mechanism: A uses its old picnic lessons to turn questions about separation into pupil exercises on food.
confusable: Not innocent distraction: B explicitly asks why A requested distance, and A deliberately assigns another topic.
comparison: Outdoor practical lesson versus wedding-video interpretation.
seedUse: D86 picnic/space/mustard; S05 corrections turn painful inquiry into tasting exercise.
